rows.notes: The paper is a three-page system design proposal (Raspberry Pi, soil moisture and temperature sensors, Android app) with an architecture figure, a module breakdown and a step-by-step algorithm. It reports no data, experiment, deployment, survey or model runs; the 'Result and Discussion' section only lists the system modules. Water saving and reduced manual intervention are asserted in the abstract and conclusion as design aims, not measured. No own evidence that smart irrigation addresses water scarcity.

notes: Short conference-style design paper without any empirical results; all questions answered 'no' because it does not qualify as a primary study.
